title: Battle of Tamai
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Tamai", at revision 1370590470, opens: "The Battle of Tamai took place on 13 March 1884 between a British force under Sir Gerald Graham and a Mahdist Sudanese army led by Osman Digna." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q604356, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1884 battle of the Mahdist War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
